hooks.expectedPayoff: The nature and origin of Aldric's mana pressure sensation — why it manifests, what it means, why it is different from standard cultivation
hooks.notes: Ch. 1: two brief flickers (sternum, concealed from Daran). Ch. 2: one sustained, body-wide pressure event at night (chest and hands, spreading outward) — longer than Ch. 1 flickers, still private and unwitnessed; Aldric files it away and goes to sleep. Pressure is developing in duration and scope. No witness event occurred in Ch. 2 despite chapter memo intent — the shimmer/witness beat was not written; this must be carried forward to Ch. 3 or later.

hooks.expectedPayoff: Daran's declaration "We'll both get in" — the promise that will be broken when Daran fails the practical mana assessment
hooks.notes: Daran present in Ch. 2 but the "we'll both get in" declaration is not repeated; Daran mentions the spring assessor review and suggests Aldric request one too — the shared-path assumption continues undisturbed. Promise undisturbed per chapter memo intent. Defer payoff to Ch. 6–7.

hooks.expectedPayoff: Josse's observation "you'll know when it changes — because you won't be able to set it aside" — what does Josse know or suspect about Aldric's pressure sensation?
hooks.notes: Josse's phrasing is oddly precise for a man who has not been told about the pressure events; raises the question of whether he has observed something Aldric does not know he has shown, or whether he is speaking from general wisdom. Unresolved. Expected payoff: Ch. ~5 (departure scene) or Arc 2.

hooks.expectedPayoff: Maren's explicit statement "You're going to get in" — delivered with certainty, not hope; what does Maren know or believe about Aldric that grounds this certainty?
hooks.notes: Maren says this without qualification and pivots immediately; her certainty is not explained. Connects to the broader question of what the adoptive parents know about Aldric's origins and nature. Expected payoff: Arc 1 close or Arc 2.
